description: Lint a Solidity source string that is not on disk yet — generated or pasted code. For a file in the project use lint_file; to sweep the project use lint_project.

config.description: Optional Solhint config, e.g. { extends: 'solhint:recommended' }. Rule maps and solhint:* presets only; 'extends' paths and 'plugins' are rejected.

name: lint_solidity
